fixed_assignment_rule: Latest batch passing individual release, delivery, pickup and final-unload necessary conditions; keep orders with no legal batch and flag the rejection
source_preservation: Do not change network, quantities, windows, service, use time, release, fleet, cleaning, cycle bounds or costs. Only reference calendar and batch labels are adapted.
m5_pool_rule: N=Q explicitly; also report the minimum pool for each obtained unchanged schedule
limitations: Individual necessary conditions do not guarantee simultaneous routing feasibility
No failed case is removed or repaired by relaxing physical inputs
Synthetic costs and appointments; paired variants are not independent samples
